facts.fact: 官府的人走后，姐妹俩在巷子里站了很久，Jingling 握住姐姐的手，Kiamling 把那手拉近身侧。
facts.anchor: after the imperial officer finally left

facts.fact: Kiamling 低声问祖母到底还瞒着什么；她气祖母反复讲正直，却把许多事瞒着亲孙女。
facts.anchor: What other secrets was Por Por keeping?

facts.fact: Kiamling 以为妹妹要指认她是没敢跳进那道裂隙的懦夫，Jingling 却沉默着出神。
facts.anchor: a coward for not jumping through the rift

facts.fact: 两人回到旅店，Kiamling 坐不住，Hoi 看了一眼就把她们又带回夜市。
facts.anchor: They returned to the boarding house

facts.fact: 她想起与 Hoi 在夜市讨剩饭、偷摊上吃食的那些夜晚。
facts.anchor: pilfering from stalls

facts.fact: 在广州练武像一场摸清规则的游戏；搬来香港、父母死后，那条拴她与家族传承的绳子再没有余量。
facts.anchor: any slack she had on the rope that tied her to the family legacy

facts.fact: Hoi 说她太小看妹妹，Jingling 比她以为的更强。
facts.anchor: She is stronger than you give her credit for

facts.fact: Kiamling 被激怒，赌气叫 Hoi 再走远一些。
facts.anchor: Go further this time.

facts.fact: 邋遢的乞丐 So 其实是广东十虎之一、有名号的武师，也是她旧日师父之一。
facts.anchor: one of the Ten Tigers of Canton

facts.fact: 乞丐帮靠流动的活法织出最好的情报网，街上没人会多看一眼乞丐。
facts.anchor: nobody looked twice at a beggar on the street

facts.fact: 乞丐 So 说细节只有祖母自己知道。
facts.anchor: your grandmother kept those to herself

facts.fact: 他告诉姐妹：她们父母是太平军。
facts.anchor: Your parents were Taiping rebels.

facts.fact: 他说广州对姐妹悬了赏，有英国军队在，香港才不敢动手。
facts.anchor: there’s a bounty on all your heads

facts.fact: 他把浑仪塞进她手里，说这是她父亲的。
facts.anchor: It belonged to your father.

facts.fact: 她看出浑仪的铜环不为测星，是为标出灵界的位置。
facts.anchor: It maps the spirit realm.

facts.fact: 她推断祖母困在番鬼的灵界，或两者之间。
facts.anchor: Trapped not in our underworld, but in the gweilo spirit world

facts.fact: 浑仪指出的下一个窗口是除夕前夜，她只剩三个月。
facts.anchor: The eve of the new year.

facts.fact: 门外有人砸门喝令开门，她天眼里看见十几个人影，随后传来枪声。
facts.anchor: incandescent demands to open up

facts.fact: 符和钱剑对人没用，她抄起一条咸鱼朝对方脸上打。
facts.anchor: a sizeable dried fish

facts.fact: 妹妹把自己的气渡过来，她踏水跑到 Hoi 的船上。
facts.anchor: channelling her own qi across to her

facts.fact: 她宁愿在香港对付怪物，也不愿在广州对付活人打手。
facts.anchor: flesh-and-blood thugs in Canton
